sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:52

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:52:1
items.html:
The female is judgments, and she is of the discernment of the clarification of the kings; and how can the name “female” rightly apply to Atik and AA, who are the utmost of mercy: You already know that all the Partzufim of Atzilut are regarded as one Partzuf, as above in the words of the ARI (page 630, item 35), for Atik and AA are regarded only as the root for the Mochin of Atzilut, in which the coupling is made for the sake of those Mochin, and after they are formed there, they are born and come to their place, which are called AVI of Atzilut. And those that receive the Mochin are called by the name ZON of Atzilut, who are the revelation of Atzilut, and from them the worlds are influenced. As above (page 630, the passage beginning “and all”).
And the reason for this matter, you shall understand according to their relation to the ten Sefirot of direct light. For the uppermost discernment in every Partzuf is the essence of the Partzuf, and the Partzuf is called by its name — for example, if the uppermost discernment is Keter, the entire Partzuf is called by the name Keter. And this indicates that the discernment of Keter of direct light rests upon the entire Partzuf, and so on — you shall understand accordingly.
Therefore, in the Partzufim of Keter, it is impossible for the name female to exist there. For the name female indicates a lack within her that requires completion by the male related to her, and this is possible only from Hochma downward, which is the discernment of the beginning of the expansion of the light from Ein Sof to the receiver. But Keter, which is the root and is the discernment of Ein Sof — meaning that the light has not yet moved to come within the category of a receiver, but stands in the discernment of a root, from which the light will expand to the receiver — if so, how can the name female exist there?
And this is what he said: “And how can the name female rightly apply to Atik and AA, who are the utmost of mercy,” for they are the discernment of complete bestowal, in which there is no discernment of reception whatsoever. However, in truth, there is no discernment of Nukva there at all, as will continue to be explained, but rather, what we call by the name Nukva in this place also indicates, from the discernment of the root, that there is a bestowal unique to the male, and a bestowal unique to the Nukva, and after these two roots we call them by the name male and female, as will be explained before us.
